interface Box<T> { value: T; optional?: T; }
type Unexpected<T> = Box<T>["missing"];
type TooFar<T> = [T, T][2];
function get<T>(value: Box<T>["optional"]): T { return value; }
function first<T>(value: T[][0]): string { return value; }
function pick<T extends { name: string }>(value: T["name"]): string { return value; }
function narrow<T extends { name: string }>(value: string): T["name"] { return value; }
